entries.statement: TypeScript stays pinned to ~5.9 until typescript-eslint announces TS 7 support.
entries.rationale: TS 7 is a native compiler without the JS API required by @typescript-eslint; upgrading breaks lint tooling.

entries.statement: Components stay on the custom Block class with Handlebars templates; no UI frameworks.
entries.rationale: The project is an educational framework-free messenger; introducing a framework defeats its purpose.

entries.statement: Imports are written with the .ts extension (moduleResolution: bundler).
entries.rationale: allowImportingTsExtensions is enabled; extensionless or .js imports fail typecheck.

entries.statement: Evidence verdicts come from the repository's single deterministic verification chain (typecheck, tests, lint), never from prose.
entries.rationale: Plan manifests cite this chain as their validation command; conclusions must be reproducible.

entries.statement: The bats workflow (tests.yml) and the sprint_* / deploy branches belong to the course pipeline and stay untouched.
entries.rationale: Course CI runs external Yandex Practicum autotests on sprint PRs; modifying it breaks the educational flow.
